Sophie (CS): Heads up — AtlasPulse goes live in APAC pilot tomorrow. They're seeing 95th latency spikes when traffic falls back to EU. Request: add two egress IP CIDRs to APAC edge allowlist, temp QPS bump 200->600 for 48h, and honor header pin `X-Redwood-Region: apac1`. This pilot impacts a renewal in ~6w so high priority.

Raj (NetOps): Ok. CIDRs and start window? We need an infra change ticket and to stage smoke tests.

Sophie (CS): CIDRs: 203.0.113.8/29, 198.51.100.0/28. Start: 2025-04-03T03:00Z for 48h, auto-revoke at end.

Ana (Solutions): Suggest prefix KV warmup and prefix_cache:true on their route, and `int8-lite` quant for chat. Should reduce token stalls.

Raj (NetOps): Created INFR-9123: add CIDRs to peering ACLs, set header region pin to apac1, apply temp QPS 600 scoped to those IPs/route for 48h. Staging ETA ~2h.

Sophie (CS): Sample config:
```json
{"route":"atlas-pulse-prod","allowlist":["203.0.113.8/29","198.51.100.0/28"],"region_pin_header":"X-Redwood-Region","region_pin_value":"apac1","temp_qps":600,"auto_revoke":"2025-04-05T03:00Z"}
```

deploy-bot: INFR-9123 queued. Smoke tests to run: routing, TLS, metrics.

Raj (NetOps): Staging change applied, smoke passed. Prod rollout scheduled at window; auto-revoke set.

Mike (CS): I'll confirm times with customer and set 30m enablement to review header pin and cache warmup. Action items: Sophie update renewal notes, Leo track contract options if they need ongoing capacity, Ana schedule perf follow-up, Raj monitor metrics during window.

Sophie (CS): Customer note: "we saw tokenization stalls ~1.2s on big prompts" — added to enablement agenda. Closing internal loop after prod change completes.
